summary: Worksport Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of 675,529 shares of common stock at $0.70 per share, representing a discount to the $0.74 last sale. The company is using D. Boral Capital as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, with no escrow arrangement. This is a standard equity shelf takedown under Form S-3, subject to the one-third public float limit, with net proceeds of approximately $449,226. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, restructuring, or activist involvement are present. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction.
